blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Friday filed a complaint before the Office of the Ombudsman against Commission on Human Rights (CHR) chair Richard Palpal-latoc and three others for allegedly claiming travel allowances for a trip that was already funded by a donor. The other subjects of the complaint were CHR General Administration Office director IV Onesimo Cuyco, Accounting Division chief Maria Teresa Dolor and Russel Mani. Mani’s designation was not immediately clear as his name does not appear on the CHR’s website. READ: CHR probe sought over alleged harassment of fishers; OPAPRU denies role All four […]...
